final_assessment: Sal took the leanings and the stage link. Q-rc17d-1/2/4 resolved as D-rc17d-4 (init offers, orbit config edits — config set writes scalars only, so an own argv goes through init or config edit), D-rc17d-5 (preset or argv, never a shell string; prompt on stdin; {output} required) and D-rc17d-6 (handoff commit is the launch base; return committed alone and pushed). All six rules carry Mechanism entries; one BOUNDED (D-rc17d-1: a truncated return that still parses). Q-rc17d-3 (who normalizes the return) stays open, leaning a body step — normalization is required because both external readers refuse a file not headed `# External Review:`.

residuals.kind: a return that opens with the heading and parses yet is not a complete review (a truncated run)
residuals.method: running the three external readers over the return and reading its `**Reviewer**:` line at each runner's first recorded use
